import pathlib, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import brain_prompt as B, execution_receipt as E, execution_runner as X, ledger as L, observe_output as O
assert X.BUDGET_EXIT == 121, X.BUDGET_EXIT
assert X.WORKER_TOKEN_BUDGETS == {"small": 150000, "medium": 400000, "large": 800000}, X.WORKER_TOKEN_BUDGETS
worker = [line for line in open("scripts/spawn-worker.sh", encoding="utf-8") if line.startswith("PROMPT=")]
assert len(worker) == 1 and "(small 150000, medium 400000, large 800000 tokens; medium when unset)" in worker[0], worker
assert "stops the run past twice the budget" in B.render("review", "m", "claude").split("## Budget", 1)[1], "brain budget sentence"
assert "budget_exceeded" in E.OUTCOMES and L.OUTCOMES[-1] == "budget_exceeded", L.OUTCOMES
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    for fm, want in (("size: small\n", 150000), ("size: large\n", 800000), ("", 400000), ("size: huge\n", 400000)):
        pathlib.Path(d, "t.md").write_text("---\ntask_id: T-001\n" + fm + "---\n# Task\nsize: small\n", encoding="utf-8")
        got = X.token_budget({"role": "worker", "repo": d, "work_unit": "T-001"}, "t.md")
        assert got == want, (fm, got)
    assert X.token_budget({"role": "worker", "repo": d, "work_unit": "T-002"}, "missing.md") == 400000
for unit, role in (("mission-init", "planning"), ("gate0", "gate"), ("plan", "planning"), ("review", "review")):
    assert X.token_budget({"role": "brain", "repo": "/nonexistent", "work_unit": unit}, None) == B.BUDGETS[role], unit
u = {"input_tokens": 5, "output_tokens": 2, "cache_read_input_tokens": 3}
seen = set()
msg = lambda mid, parent: {"type": "assistant", "parent_tool_use_id": parent, "message": {"id": mid, "usage": u, "content": []}}
assert [O.stream_tokens("claude", e, seen) for e in (msg("m1", None), msg("m1", None), msg("m2", "toolu_1"), msg("m3", None))] == [10, 0, 0, 10]
assert O.stream_tokens("claude", {"type": "result", "usage": u}, set()) == 0
assert O.stream_tokens("codex", {"type": "turn.completed", "usage": {"input_tokens": 5, "cached_input_tokens": 3, "output_tokens": 2}}, set()) == 10
assert O.stream_tokens("agent", {"type": "result", "usage": {"inputTokens": 5, "outputTokens": 2, "cacheReadTokens": 3}}, set()) == 10
assert O.stream_tokens("agy", {"event": "result", "result": {"usage": {"input_tokens": 5, "output_tokens": 2, "cache_read_tokens": 3}}}, set()) == 10
assert O.stream_tokens("codex", {"type": "turn.completed", "usage": {"input_tokens": "5", "output_tokens": True}}, set()) == 0
print("ok")
